amazonInfluencer: Sign in at https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/ (Associates) and/or Influencer: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/home/influencers
Confirm the site likeleaders.com (and Facebook if required) is listed under Accounts / Sites & apps — add the domain if missing and wait for approval if prompted.
Copy your Store ID / tracking tag (looks like yourname-20). That is trackingCode for amazon + amazon-influencer.
Optional: create an Influencer storefront (Shop) and paste its public URL into storefrontUrl.
In Site Stripe / Profile, use the same disclosure language already on likeleaders.com footers.
Drop the tag into partners.json → partners id amazon and amazon-influencer → trackingCode, set status to live, republish data/partners.json.
ebayAmbassador: Sign in to eBay Partner Network (EPN): https://partnernetwork.ebay.com/ (Ambassador / Creator programs often route here).
Add likeleaders.com as a website property / placement if the dashboard asks for it.
Create a campaign (or use default) and copy your Campaign ID / custom link tool output.
Generate product or search links with the Link Generator; the campid= parameter is your trackingCode.
Paste campid into partners.json → ebay trackingCode; set urlTemplate to keep campid={trackingCode}; status live; republish.
Keep eBay and Amazon disclosures near Shop the story modules (already loaded from disclosureNearLinks).
siteWireOrder: Do not click/promote until domain + disclosures are accepted in each dashboard.
Put real tags only in partners.json (never hardcode secrets beyond public affiliate tags).
Spot-check Diamond District / Visit America Shop the story cards — pending badges should disappear.
Optional: add Facebook post links that point to the same tagged URLs for Influencer/Ambassador attribution continuity.
